extraction: Summary fields only; raw samples, per-frame records, maxima and telemetry omitted. Historical status fields retained verbatim.

data.status: All new terminal-INT8 candidates rejected on actual decoder quality. Accepted engine unchanged; goal active.
data.finding: A stored RGB-frame quality gate alone was insufficient. The fast 16-block candidate passed stored RGB but failed when fed actual GPU-decoded frames. The original terminal INT8 engine with full FP16 residual state also fails the actual decoder gate.
data.correction_experiment: Using 255 correction codes plus one FP16 escape per byte passed independent kernel arithmetic checks, but worsened full-model image quality. The cause of that additional full-model degradation is not established; do not claim higher local reconstruction precision guarantees better network quality.
data.quality_protocol: Both FP32 and original AMP reference: mean PSNR loss <= 0.05 dB; worst-frame loss <= 0.10 dB. 24 frozen Mac development clips, 72 frames, 720p/600 Kbps/4:2:0. No test-set selection or retraining.
data.scope: Same trained architecture/checkpoint, but 32 instead of 30 residual convolutions use INT8, and 15 instead of 14 intermediate residual boundaries use byte correction state. This changes numerical precision, not just scheduling.
data.timing_scope: Actual NVDEC runs use the first frozen clip replayed for 1000 serial samples. GPU pixels only; excludes network, demux, pacing, display presentation and encoding.

default_transform.scope: CPU graph transformation only; default 15-block mode matches frozen accepted ONNX bytes.

verification.earlier_default_check: First full default-kernel harness reported 3 CUDA API diagnostics from PyTorch CUB nonzero used by boolean indexing. Equivalent dense selection removes that helper; the revised check passes with default API reporting enabled. Original log preserved.
verification.environment_failure: First transform regression mixed Triton 3.5 with the existing Triton 3.2 entry plugin and failed import. Separate compiler paths fixed the harness; default ONNX bytes match the frozen accepted graph.
verification.full_engine_limit: Earlier full TensorRT-engine default CUDA API diagnostics remain unresolved. These independent kernel checks do not establish full-engine sanitizer cleanliness.

handoff_attribution.scope: Prior 25-frame NV12 trace; correlation IDs connect first CUDA work to its driver launch call. Profiler attribution only, not a new timing run.
limits: No NVVIDEO decoder API rows; hardware-done-to-launch delay cannot be assigned to cuvidMapVideoFrame or a specific function without new instrumentation.
Launch-start-to-GPU-start overlaps the launch call; do not add launch duration to this interval.

remaining: Current qualified GPU decode-to-output result is still approximately 10.5 ms, not below 10 ms.
Desktop viewer still reads decoded planes into CPU bytes and writes textures; optional CUDA input/output API is not yet integrated with presentation.
RTX 4090 timing does not establish Mac client performance; PSNR gates do not establish OCR/readability equivalence.
